notes.title: Runa & The Chaikurú Legacy - AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576667/442e72bcfe30d45751a59cd893551d6cc11e82a9.jpg[/img]

[b]The moment we’ve all been waiting for is finally here! 🎮
[/b]
Dive into the exciting world of Runa and the Chaikurú Legacy, a 3D platformer packed with action, puzzles, and unforgettable moments!

✨ What can you expect from this epic adventure?
[list]
[*] Pet adorable capybaras: Yes, you read that right! Find them and give them some love—these cuddly friends might become your most unexpected allies. 🦫💖
[*] Collect magical amethysts: Discover dazzling gems that hold secrets and powers essential to your journey.
[*] Drink mate to recover HP: It’s not just a drink—it’s your lifeline! Restore your energy with a refreshing sip. 🧉
[*] Explore and gather unique collectibles: Can you uncover all the hidden secrets in the mysterious Chaikurú Ruins?
[*] Upgrade your skills: Find the sacred seals and enhance your abilities to overcome every challenge. 💪
[*] Face challenging enemies: Each battle will test your reflexes and strategies. Are you ready to prove your worth?
[*] Uncover the mysteries of an ancient civilization: Join Runa in unraveling the secrets of the mythical Chaikurú culture and uncover its magical legacy.
[/list]
🌟 The world is brimming with magic, challenges, and capybaras! 🌟
[b]👉 Available NOW on Steam.
[/b]
Don’t wait any longer—start your adventure today and discover everything Runa and the Chaikurú Legacy has to offer! 🌍✨
We can’t wait for you to experience this unique journey!

notes.title: Alpha v0.9.0
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha v09.0[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576667/46679931f81e10094f9204612966e254a546ec12.png[/img]

[h3]New chapter soon![/h3]
Most of the stuff we've been working on these last months was new levels, enemies, npcs and mechanics for chapter 2, which sadly isn't included in this release.
However, next changelogs will go deeper into details of chapter 2 since it'll be playable soon.

[h3]Fixed Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Murgos used to immediately perform a melee attack if their ranged attack was interrupted
[*] In Tuco's meny, Tuco was displayed in front of the buttons.
[*] Mouse couldn't be used during pause if there was an active dialogue with an npc.
[/list]

[h3]Art and graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Accesibility related improvements.
[*] Added more hats for the capybaras.
[*] Added new artifacts.
[/list]

[h3]Performance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the use of materials and size of textures.
[*] Removed stutter that happened each time a dialogue started.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the invincibility window Runa gets after being damaged.
[*] Tweaked Runa's movement so it instantly takes the direction the player chose.
[*] Reduced damage window of jaguarete's charged attack.
[*] Added a system to unstuck the player if they were ever stuck on a collision with the terrain.
[/list]

[h3]Sound:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Master volume can be modified from the configuration menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha v0.8.0
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha v08.0[/h1]

[h3]Fixed Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a memory leak that happened when going back to a checkpoint.
[*] Corrected observatory road's terrain where Runa could get stuck.
[*] When respawning from a fall, Runa could appear with velocity and fall again. This was fixed so that she respawns with zero velocity.
[/list]

[h3]Art and Graphics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] There are little birds in the world 🐦.
[*] Improved the texture of a door inside the air temple.
[*] Enhanced textures of the escape level and the air temple terrain.
[*] The condor seal has been updated with a new image.
[*] Better VFX in the seals' cinematics.
[*] Buttons and pressure plates are more noticeable.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Observatory has been remodeled!
[*] There are new cinematics in the observatory.
[*] Added visual indicator for jumping.
[*] The amaconda is a bit slower in the second phase of the boss fight.
[*] There are now stonake eggs around the amaconda egg.
[*] If you try to return to the air temple after finishing it, Narinas will call you to stop you.
[*] Adjustments were made to make the cemetery exit path easier to find.
[*] Improved feedback when hitting breakable rocks.
[*] It is no longer possible to fall while hitting the big ball in the escape level.
[*] Issues with the charged attack vfx have been fixed.
[/list]

[h3]Audio and Sound:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now, when the camera zooms out in cinematics, the sound adjusts appropriately.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha v0.7.0
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha v0.7.0[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576667/b3240be71af477a3856d136be0143f796105f309.png[/img]

[h3]Fixed bugs[/h3]

[list]
[*]The knockback applied to enemies made them rotate incorrectly.
[*]The game crashed after the bossfight.
[*]When the toucannon was deployed in the chaikurú ruins, the first shot would not exit the cannon if its position wasn't changed from the initial position.
[*]In the road to the observatory, the tortoise-clocks changed texture when activated.
[*]Fixed several places where Runa could get stuck.
[*]During the escape sequence, the Amaconda was able to kill you without actually catching you.
[*]There was a graphic glitch when using the jaguar seal power.
[/list]

[h3]Art & graphics[/h3]

[list]
[*]Enhaced vfx for boleadoras' trails when using the seal powers.
[*]The escape sequence now happens during the night.
[*]Replaced the breakable rock models for new ones. Now they have feedback as they are being broken.
[*]Improve the pile of leaves in the stonake pit.
[*]Improved lights in the main menu.
[*]Improved cinematic at the end of chapter 1.
[*]Unified how the water looks on all levels.
[*]Improved visibility of platforms in the road to the observatory.
[*]Added game over animation to Runa.
[*]Added animation that indicates when the bossfight advanced to a next phase.
[*]Fixed floor textures where different zones are connected.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[list]
[*]Replaced invisible walls by rocks at the labyrinth's entrance.
[*]Runa can kick the balls that appear in the puzzles.
[*]Tweaked breakable trees so it's easier to walk over them.
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]

[list]
[*]Added sounds to the toucannon.
[/list]

During the escape sequence, the Amaconda was able to kill you without actually catching you.
There was a graphic glitch when using the jaguar seal power.
Fixed floor textures where different zones are connected.

notes.title: Alpha v0.6.0
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha v0.6.0[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576667/ef15d6a1a286cf221c054f3ff99c9a5856ea8128.gif[/img]

[h3]General[/h3]

[list]
[*] Runa runs on mac.
[/list]

[h3]Fixed bugs[/h3]

[list]
[*] Pressing back/circle during the game over screen freezes the game.
[*] Sound effects were lacking in the labyrinth.
[*] The labyrinth could be stuck in such a way that returning to last checkpoint was the only way out.
[*] Archaeologyst who lost his cards lied about how many cards he had lost.
[*] The graphics settings weren't saved correctly. Now all they do except the resolution.
[/list]

[h3]Art and graphics[/h3]

[list]
[*] New image for runa's book.
[*] During the Chaikurú Ruins intro cinematic, we fixed an empty void that was noticeable on the air temple door.
[*] Fixed terrain where the cascade connects with the entrance to the Chaikurú Ruins.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[list]
[*] Amethyts that are high in the air have a bigger magnetism area.
[*] Changes to some cameras in the monkey's tower to make it easier to navigate.
[/list]

tags.bug: - Pressing back/circle during the game over screen freezes the game.
- Sound effects were lacking in the labyrinth.
- The labyrinth could be stuck in such a way that returning to last checkpoint was the only way out.
- Archaeologyst who lost his cards lied about how many cards he had lost.
- The graphics settings weren't saved correctly. Now all they do except the resolution.

notes.title: Alpha v0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha v0.5.0[/h1]

[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576667/ba56c7ef0ab184fcbab7e16705012457e04742b6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New loading screen. Fixed several issues that caused FPS drops during the first minutes of the game.
[/list]


[h3]Gameplay enhancements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576667/49128bbb3518c6189954d0319c8bf7172a807a2d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Chaikurú ruins have been completely revamped.
[*] There are more NPCs in the Chaikurú Ruins.
[*] Amount of mate dropped by enemies has been balanced.
[*] Replaced several pressure plates by flip buttons.
[/list]

[h3]Artistic enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Walls' transparency was replaced by a silhouette that is drawn when Runa is behind something that blocks the camera.
[*] Improvements on the main camera to avoid buildings and walls from blocking the camera as much as possible in the first section of the game.
[*] Book's font has been updated.
[*] Dialogues' UI has been changed. Now it's more consistent with the rest of the game UIs.
[*] VSync can be turned on in the graphic settings.
[*] Runa has an animation to collect artifacts now.
[/list]

[h3]Fixed bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A message saying that a saved game will be overwritten was being displayed when pressing new game for the first time.

[*] Fixed music played when getting one of the seals.

[*] Added Yaguareté seal mark to elements that can be interacted by using that seal.
[*] Added some more hints to the Narinas' walkie-talkie.
[*] Bossfight was redesigned.
[/list]
